content.text:
**Finding: Deviation (high severity) — § 14.10 Assignment (p0188)**

The clause is one-sided. It restricts only our assignment (consent of IBM required), gives us a narrow successor carve-out limited to "merger, consolidation or acquisition" (no affiliate transfers, no sale of substantially all assets), and leaves IBM entirely free to assign — including to a competitor of ours. On the positive side, I confirmed there is no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right anywhere in the Agreement (no hits for "change of control"), so we are not at the walk-away threshold.

Redline submitted (validated ok): make the consent requirement mutual with the "not unreasonably withheld" standard applying both ways, bar IBM from assigning to a Customer competitor, expand our carve-out to Affiliates and to a sale of all or substantially all assets, and state expressly that our change of control gives IBM no termination, suspension or re-pricing right. Fallback offered in the comment if IBM resists full mutuality.
